title: Intercepted letter from Brussels to Mr Copinger, 12 Aug 1656 (Thurloe State Papers v.267): a name and a word in digits

documents.shelfmark: Bodleian Rawlinson A vol. xli p. 78; printed TSP v.267

transcription.source: Birch, Thurloe State Papers (1742) via British History Online
transcription.notes: Single digits: a 12-sign name and a 4-sign word inside a clear English sentence.

system.summary: A ten-symbol digit cipher: a 12-sign name and a 4-sign word in a clear English letter.
system.sibling_key: Every 1653-60 royalist and Commonwealth key on cryptiana (Marshall, Barwick-Hyde, Stamford, Butler, Charles II intercepted, Kingston, Westrope, Hague agent/Blake) tried; none fits.
system.notes: Name pattern ABCDEDFDGEAB, word HGBE; the crib 'the king' forces an impossible name, so the digits are not a plain letter alphabet or the word is not 'king'. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from the four-piece thurloe entry.

prior_solution.where: Listed as undeciphered by Tomokiyo (cryptiana item #9); Birch's transcriptions are the only online witness and carry no decipherment.

tools: apply_keys.py (period keys scored by quadgram LM)

solution.what: Extracted piece (c) from Birch's Thurloe State Papers on British History Online.

Applied every 1653-60 royalist and Commonwealth key from cryptiana (Marshall, Barwick-Hyde, Stamford, Butler, Charles II intercepted 1655, Kingston, Westrope, Hague agent/Blake) to piece (c) with apply_keys.py, scored by quadgram models: nothing readable.
(c) 'the king' for the 4-sign word forces an impossible name pattern; unresolvable at 16 symbols.
Split under the one-key rule from thurloe (four unrelated pieces of the Thurloe State Papers): piece (c) gets its own entry; ciphertext file moved here; shared scripts stay in targets/thurloe/.

outcome.method_basis: Sixteen single digits (a name and a word) that no 1653-60 key on cryptiana reads; the crib 'the king' fails on the name pattern; too short for anything more.
outcome.notes: Original in Bodleian Rawlinson A vol. xli, not digitised; Birch's print is the only witness. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from thurloe.

credits.note: Thurloe State Papers (1742): the only witness of the four intercepts
